shortDefinition.en: A digital camera format with a nominal 36 × 24 mm recording area, commonly used as an equivalence reference.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 标称记录范围为 36 × 24 mm 的数码相机画幅，常作为等效比较参考。

en: Full frame is a physical format, not a guarantee of better photographs in every situation.
zh-cn: 全画幅是物理画幅，不保证在任何情况下都拍出更好的照片。

example.en: A 75 mm full-frame lens can provide a reference view for a 50 mm lens on a nominal 1.5× APS-C camera.
example.zh-cn: 标称 1.5× APS-C 上的 50 mm 镜头，可用全画幅 75 mm 视角作比较。

sources.title: The DX and FX Formats — Nikon
